title: Deus Ex: Human Revolution - Director's Cut
default_path: C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Deus Ex Human Revolution - Director's Cut\DXHRDC.exe

fixes.name: wiz3D (AMD HD3D native)
fixes.pros: Game has undocumented AMD HD3D native stereo support — wiz3D unlocks it on non-AMD GPUs too. No shader patching needed; the game renders both eyes itself.
fixes.cons: Skybox at wrong depth (per wiz3D notes). Some shader effects may still benefit from a per-game iZ3D Shader Fix.
fixes.notes: Undocumented AMD HD3D support. Skybox at wrong depth, check iZ3D Shader Fix.

fixes.name: Vireio Perception
fixes.pros: Open-source stereo + 6DOF headtracking via OpenTrack. Per-game shader profile bundled in the Vireio v3 catalogue.
fixes.cons: DX9-era rendering path — wiz3D HD3D native is usually a better fit for this DX11 title.
fixes.notes: Profile maps to Vireio v3 rule file 'DXHRDC.xml'. Architecture: 32bit.

fixes.name: wiz3D (AMD 3D Vision Direct Mode (wiz3D)
fixes.pros: Game has undocumented AMD HD3D native stereo support — wiz3D unlocks it on non-AMD GPUs too. No shader patching needed; the game renders both eyes itself.
fixes.cons: Skybox at wrong depth (per wiz3D notes). Some shader effects may still benefit from a per-game iZ3D Shader Fix.
fixes.notes: Cross-mapped from HD3D native — wiz3D can also drive the original Nvidia 3D Vision Direct Mode for this game (Sniper Elite + Zombie Army franchises excepted).
